name: Chibidol ~Ecchi na Suiei Kyoushitsu~
original_name: ちびドル〜エッチな水泳教室〜
source:
Freelance swimming instructor Kijima Gunzou receives a request.
It was to give swimming lessons for FruiCHU ☆ Daughter, an idol unit of beautiful girls, who he is a big fan of himself!
Gunzou's plan was to hide the fact that he's a fan and get acquainted with the girls in respectful manner, but the girls' charming bodies keep driving him crazy.

What lies ahead when things get out of control...?

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/estof_0001/]DMM[/url]]
translation:
自由教练木岛群三接到一份委托：为他非常喜欢的美少女偶像组合FruiCHU☆Daughter教授游泳！群三原本打算隐藏粉丝身份，以礼貌方式接近女孩们，但她们迷人的身体不断让他失控。
事情失控后，等待他的会是什么……？

[译自[url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/estof_0001/]DMM[/url]]
